description: This file defines the EmployeeOnLeaveService class in the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin, responsible for handling business logic related to employees on leave. It includes a constant for configuration purposes and manages a data access object (DAO) for employee leave data.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveService
classes.description: Service class managing employee leave data interactions, providing access to the DAO responsible for database operations related to employees on leave.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveDao
methods.description: Retrieves the EmployeeOnLeaveDao instance, creating it if it does not already exist.
